prompt:
You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate,
        STDDEV("loss_rate_%") as stddev_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
)
SELECT 
    AVG(s.avg_loss_rate) as avg_loss_rate,
    AVG(s.stddev_loss_rate) as stddev_loss_rate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%"< s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as below_stddev,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%"> s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as above_stddev,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%">= s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate AND v."loss_rate_%"<= s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as within_stddev
FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s

[B]
SQL:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate,
        STDDEV("loss_rate_%") as std_dev_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
with_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        s.avg_loss_rate,
        s.std_dev_loss_rate,
        v."loss_rate_%" as lr,
        CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < (s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as below,
        CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > (s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as above,
        CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" >= (s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate) 
             AND v."loss_rate_%" <= (s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate) 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as within
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df v
    CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT 
    ANY_VALUE(avg_loss_rate) as avg_loss_rate,
    ANY_VALUE(std_dev_loss_rate) as std_dev_loss_rate,
    SUM(below) as below_std_dev,
    SUM(above) as above_std_dev,
    SUM(within) as within_std_dev
FROM with_stats

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate,
        STDDEV("loss_rate_%") as stddev_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
thresholds AS (
    SELECT 
        avg_loss_rate - stddev_loss_rate as lower_bound,
        avg_loss_rate + stddev_loss_rate as upper_bound
    FROM stats
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) as total_items,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" < lower_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) as count_below,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" > upper_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) as count_above,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" >= lower_bound AND "loss_rate_%" <= upper_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) as count_within,
    ROUND(AVG("loss_rate_%"), 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(STDDEV("loss_rate_%"), 2) as stddev_loss_rate,
    ROUND(avg_loss_rate - stddev_loss_rate, 2) as lower_bound,
    ROUND(avg_loss_rate + stddev_loss_rate, 2) as upper_bound
FROM veg_loss_rate_df, thresholds
